hints.title: Consecutive Color Groups
hints.text: When several consecutive balloons have the same color, only one balloon may remain.

hints.title: Retain the Most Expensive Balloon
hints.text: To minimize removal cost, greedily keep the single balloon with the maximum neededTime in that consecutive group.

hints.title: Group Removal Cost
hints.text: For each consecutive group of identical colors, add (sum of all times in group - maximum time in group) to the total cost.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minCost(self, colors: str, neededTime: list[int]) -> int:
        ans = 0
        cur_max = neededTime[0]
        cur_sum = neededTime[0]
        for i in range(1, len(colors)):
            if colors[i] == colors[i - 1]:
                cur_sum += neededTime[i]
                cur_max = max(cur_max, neededTime[i])
            else:
                ans += cur_sum - cur_max
                cur_sum = neededTime[i]
                cur_max = neededTime[i]
        ans += cur_sum - cur_max
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: DP with state space is unnecessary when greedy selection within contiguous segments is strictly optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single forward pass tracking current run sum and run maximum operates in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that minimizing removal cost is equivalent to maximizing the single retained element per equal-color block.
complexity.notes: No two consecutive balloons may have the same color.
